In a March 22, 1839, letter to Isaac Galland, Joseph Smith refers to “five children.” The fifth child was apparently Johanna Carter, an orphan who would have been about fifteen in 1839. There is some evidence that Johanna was staying with the Smiths in Far West and that she was still with Emma Smith in Quincy; Joseph again mentioned Johanna among his children in an April 4, 1839, letter to Emma. (Joseph Smith to Isaac Galland, Mar. 22, 1839, inJSP,D6:382;Joseph Smith to Emma Smith, Apr. 4, 1839, inJSP,D6:404; see alsoJSP,D6:382, note 674; 404, note 817.)
